notes: Read all 73 source lines line by line before editing. InputCommandTile is a presentational command-palette tile: a clickable GlassPanel showing the command icon (or a Loader2 spinner while loading), a translated label + optional sublabel, an optional last-status line, and a top-left favorite toggle. Every prop/state name, the i18n keys + English fallbacks, the variant->border mapping, and the early-return-while-loading click guard are preserved.

Imports L1-5: L1 react-i18next useTranslation -> inline native-safe useNativeTranslationFallback t(key, fallback) (no i18n runtime in the parity tree; same pattern as sibling CommandSearch/ChatMessageItem ports). L2 `@/lib/cn` cn -> dropped (RN uses StyleSheet). L3 `@/components/ui` Button (as ControlButton) + GlassPanel -> native GlassPanel (../../../../components/ui/GlassPanel) wrapped in a Pressable, and the favorite Button -> a nested ghost Pressable. L4 lucide-react Loader2 -> react-native ActivityIndicator; Star -> the canonical SemanticIcon 'star' glyph (STAR_GLYPH = getSemanticIconDefinition('star').glyph). L5 `import type { CommandDef } from '../commands'` -> a focused local native CommandDef interface (commands.ts not yet ported); the lucide `icon: LucideIcon` field is modelled as a native `SemanticIconName` resolved to a glyph at render time.

InputCommandTileProps L7-14 ported verbatim: def:CommandDef, onRequestDialog:(def)=>void, loading:boolean, lastStatus?:string, isFavorite:boolean, onToggleFavorite:()=>void. No prop renamed or dropped. The local CommandDef models exactly the fields this tile reads (labelKey, labelFallback, sublabelKey?, sublabelFallback?, icon, variant?).

hoverStyles map L16-20 (default->neon-cyan/30, danger->neon-red/30, success->neon-green/30 hover border) -> variantBorderStyles StyleSheet mapping default->colors.borderAccent (cyan), danger->colors.dangerBorder (red), success->colors.successBorder (green). Web applied this on pointer :hover; native has no hover, so the tint is applied while the tile is pressed (the equivalent interaction), gated by `pressed && !loading`. The 'as const' map keys are preserved.

Function signature L22 preserved: named `export function InputCommandTile({ def, onRequestDialog, loading, lastStatus, isFavorite, onToggleFavorite })`. InputCommandTile.displayName added (native convention; no behavioural effect).

L23 useTranslation -> const t = useNativeTranslationFallback(). L24 `const Icon = def.icon` (lucide component) -> `const iconGlyph = getSemanticIconDefinition(def.icon).glyph` (native glyph). L25 `const variant = def.variant ?? 'default'` ported verbatim. Added local `pressed` state (useState) to drive the variant border on press (native analogue of the web hover state) without a render-prop nested component (react/no-unstable-nested-components).

handleClick L27-30 ported verbatim: `if (loading) return; onRequestDialog(def);`. Wired to the outer Pressable onPress. accessibilityState={{disabled: loading}} reflects the web's loading-disabled intent (opacity-50 + click no-op) for assistive tech while keeping the favorite child independently tappable (matching the web, where the favorite Button is not disabled during loading).

GlassPanel L32-40: web `<GlassPanel className='p-4 flex flex-col items-center gap-2 ... min-h-[100px] justify-center cursor-pointer relative group' onClick={handleClick}>` -> a <Pressable onPress={handleClick}> (cursor-pointer) wrapping the native <GlassPanel>. styles.panel reproduces p-4 (padding spacing.md+spacing.xs=16), flex-col items-center (alignItems center; RN column default), gap-2 (gap spacing.sm=8), min-h-[100px] (minHeight 100), justify-center (justifyContent center), text-center (per-text textAlign center). `loading && 'opacity-50'` -> styles.panelLoading (opacity 0.5). The `group`/`relative` web hooks map to the absolutely-positioned favorite child inside the panel.

Favorite Button L41-53: web ControlButton (ghost, sm, absolute left-1.5 top-1.5, p-0.5 rounded, opacity by favorite, amber-300 when favorite, hover:bg-transparent, onClick stopPropagation->onToggleFavorite, aria-label t('commands.toggleFavorite','Toggle favorite')) -> a nested <Pressable style={styles.favorite}> (absolute left:6 top:6 = left-1.5/top-1.5, borderRadius:4 = rounded, padding:2 = p-0.5) with accessibilityRole='button', accessibilityState={{selected:isFavorite}}, hitSlop=8, onPress={onToggleFavorite}, and the SAME accessibilityLabel key+fallback. The web e.stopPropagation() is unnecessary on native: RN's responder system gives the inner Pressable the press so the outer tile onPress does not also fire.

Star L52: web `<Star className='h-3 w-3' fill-current(if fav)/>` -> STAR_GLYPH in a caption-sized bold AppText. The fill-current/active state maps to styles.favoriteActive (color colors.warning amber + opacity 1); the inactive `opacity-0 group-hover:opacity-50 text-[var(--text-muted)]` maps to styles.favoriteInactive (color colors.textMuted + opacity 0.5) — always visible (dimmed) on touch since there is no hover to reveal it.

Icon box L55-57: web `
{loading ? : }
` -> (borderRadius 12 = rounded-xl, padding spacing.sm+2=10 = p-2.5, backgroundColor colors.surfaceRaised = surface-2, centered) holding either (Loader2 spinner) or a muted bold caption AppText rendering iconGlyph (text-[var(--text-muted)]).

Labels L58-70: web outer `<div>` -> <View style={styles.labels}> (items-center). L59 label span `text-xs font-medium text-[var(--text-primary)] block` -> AppText variant='caption' (text-xs 12px) style {color textPrimary, fontWeight '500' (font-medium), textAlign center}; text = t(def.labelKey, def.labelFallback) (label const reused for the tile accessibilityLabel too). L60-64 sublabel (conditional on def.sublabelFallback) span `text-[10px] mt-0.5 font-medium text-[var(--text-muted)] block` -> AppText style {fontSize 10, marginTop 2, fontWeight '500', color textMuted, textAlign center}; text = t(def.sublabelKey ?? '', def.sublabelFallback) (the `?? ''` guard preserved). L65-69 lastStatus (conditional) span `text-[9px] mt-0.5` colored neon-green/60 when startsWith('✓') else neon-red/60 -> AppText style {fontSize 9, marginTop 2, textAlign center} + statusOk?statusOk(colors.success):statusErr(colors.danger); the `lastStatus.startsWith('✓')` test is preserved verbatim (statusOk const). Conditionals use `? ... : null` (RN cannot render a bare false/undefined as a child).
Closing tags L71-73 preserved (GlassPanel close -> GlassPanel+Pressable close, return close, function close).

No DOM/Recharts/Leaflet/react-dom/framer-motion/lucide/old web-UI imports in the native output — only react, react-native primitives (ActivityIndicator, Pressable, StyleSheet, View), the canonical SemanticIcon helpers + AppText + GlassPanel, and theme tokens (colors, spacing). No browser-only behaviour, so no explicit unavailable state is required. StyleSheet keys + properties are alphabetised (react-native/sort-styles); JSX props are alphabetised (react/jsx-sort-props).
